regimeSub: NFP preview dominates as Fed paralysis meets 1.5% GDP / 3.5% CPI trap with July jobs data due Friday.
themes: July NFP preview (CNBC Aug 6) signals soft payroll expectations → markets pricing labor cooling as stagflation validation; Warsh boxed by 3-dissent July hold
Q2 GDP 1.5% print (Jul 30) vs 3.5% CPI confirms real rate at +13bps insufficient → 10Y at 4.63% reflects term premium demand as growth slows into inflation
OPEC+ September production hike (Aug 2) normalizes post-Hormuz supply → Brent steady at $83.50 but $80+ floor signals residual geopolitical premium embedded
Korea chip exports top $40B for second month (Aug 1) as KOSPI hits 6234 → BOK caught between AI boom inflation and Fed differential; August hike odds elevated

signalNotes.note: Real rate +13bps (3.63% policy vs 3.5% CPI) offers no cushion; Fed stuck in stagflation no-man's-land

signalNotes.note: Curve at +45bps (4.63% 10Y vs 4.18% 2Y) steepening on term premium rebuild, not growth optimism

signalNotes.note: HY spreads complacent vs GDP slowdown; credit ignoring 1.5% growth print as AI earnings mask stress

signalNotes.name: Brent Crude
signalNotes.note: Brent $83.50 stable post-OPEC+ hike decision; $80 floor persists on residual Iran premium

signalNotes.name: Gold
signalNotes.note: Gold at $4316 off highs but bid sustained; real asset demand reflects fiat credibility erosion

signalNotes.name: USD / KRW
signalNotes.note: KRW at 1419 pinned by Fed differential despite BOK July hike; chip exports insufficient to break range

signalNotes.name: Semiconductor SOX
signalNotes.note: SOX rallying on TSMC capex raise and Intel/AMD surge (Aug 4); AI demand masking macro deterioration

headline: Markets hold breath ahead of Friday NFP as stagflation configuration (1.5% GDP, 3.5% CPI) traps Warsh's paralyzed Fed while chip euphoria and OPEC+ normalization mask underlying growth fragility.
